As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Our colleagues are spread across about 30 countries, and our People team is small by design. We need systems that scale as Qdrant does. As our Senior People Operations Engineer, you’ll build how People Ops runs, write the policies behind it, and automate every process that doesn’t need a human touch. You don't need "People Operations Engineer" in your title to apply. If you are an HR generalist who automates everything, or an HR systems person who has handled multi-country cases, we want to hear from you. What you will own About 60% of your time goes to running People Ops, and about 40% to building. The mix will shift with what the business needs. jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.description: Prefer a couple of hard searches to forty easy ones? You'll run a handful of searches at a time, and they're the meaty, tough-to-fill kind most in-house recruiters quietly hope land on someone else's desk. If closing a tricky role is what gets you going, you'll love this. One honest catch: most people you approach will never have heard of Taptap Send. Then you get to tell them we move billions of dollars every month across 100 countries. The job You'll join an established, high-performing recruiting team, owning searches across the business for teams in the UK, EMEA, the US and emerging markets. Own the hire end to end: intake, sourcing strategy, interview loop design, offer and pre-close. It's yours from the first call to quarterbacking the signed offer. Headhunt properly: build a tailored outbound plan for every role, blended with high-signal inbound. Real outreach, crafted to the right people. Partner with hiring managers: define what great looks like, challenge their assumptions and sharpen how they interview and decide. Run it on numbers: own the SLAs, KPIs and funnel health, and use the data to find and fix problems. Hold the bar: say no, slow down when it's needed, and protect hiring quality at all costs. Why you'll want it Get rewarded for the hard ones. The role comes with highly competitive, performance-linked variable compensation. Go where your target candidate is. If a complex search means you need to be in front of the right people somewhere else, you can travel to make it happen. Grow past the desk. Over time, there's room to move into management and leadership alongside your own recruiting. Sell something worth selling. We're growing massively year on year, and the money we move is a lifeline: remittances pay for school fees, medical bills, rent and food back home. jobs.title: HR Shared Services Lead
jobs.description: We are looking for a HR Shared Services Lead to join our People Team; as we scale up and drive digital and financial inclusion across our markets. About Us M-KOPA now serves 10 million customers and has extended $2 billion+ in credit across Kenya, Uganda, Nigeria, Ghana and South Africa. 86% of customers report an improved quality of life, 55% access formal financial services for the first time, and 70% use our products to earn income. It takes 2,300+ employees and 35,000+ field agents to make that happen. The Role You’re the one who spots the expiry date before anyone else does, notices when the data doesn’t add up, and quietly keeps the people side of a business running. This role puts that skill at the centre, and gives you the room to redesign how it’s done. What makes this different You will lead HR Shared Services across global and market client groups, own UK HR operations, and have a genuine voice in how data and AI change the way HR work gets done. Every case you close helps someone who is helping deliver financial inclusion, so the work connects to something larger than the queue. What You'll Do Run a service people trust, and learn from what it tells you. You’ll lead day-to-day delivery in Freshservice, from queue health and SLAs to escalations and quality, and turn ticket and HiBob data into reporting that shows leaders where the friction is and how to remove it. Own UK HR operations from offer to exit. That covers onboarding, right-to-work and sponsorship records, contracts, lifecycle changes, and offboarding for employees, EOR workers and contractors, all audit-ready and protected under UK GDPR. Be the safe pair of hands across payroll and benefits, then make the work lighter. You’ll back up payroll inputs, Group Benefits, NEST pensions, compensation queries and global mobility, and spot where automation and AI can take repetitive admin off people’s plates, with clear SOPs and a knowledge base so nothing lives in one person’s head. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders)
jobs.description: Talent Acquisition ist für uns mehr als Recruiting. Wir verstehen es als eine echte Disziplin, die sich stetig weiterentwickelt durch neue Technologien, neue Ansätze und vor allem durch die Menschen, die sie gestalten. Dabei zählt für uns nicht nur das Ergebnis, sondern auch der Weg dorthin. Und genau diesen Anspruch wollen wir mit dir weiterentwickeln. Als Talent Acquisition Manager (all genders) übernimmst du die End-to-end-Verantwortung für deine Hiring-Prozesse und arbeitest eng mit unserem Talent-Team zusammen. Du bringst deine Persönlichkeit und deine Werte ein und hast gleichzeitig den Raum, neue Ideen auszuprobieren und Recruiting aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei unterstützt dich ein modernes, AI-gestütztes Setup mit Ashby als ATS, Metaview als AI-Notetaker sowie Claude, Notion und Gemini. Die Technologie nimmt dir dabei nicht das Recruiting ab, sie gibt dir mehr Raum für das, worauf es wirklich ankommt: Menschen zu verstehen, die richtigen Talente zu gewinnen und gemeinsam die besten Matches zu schaffen. What to expect End-to-end Recruiting : Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess, vom Hiring Kick-off und Talent Mapping bis hin zur Vertragsunterzeichnung Sparring Partner : Du bist ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für Hiring Manager, forderst sie heraus und trägst durch deine Marktkenntnisse zur Entscheidungsfindung bei Pipeline Building : Du sprichst gezielt Talente über verschiedene Kanäle an und baust nachhaltige Talentpools durch Active Sourcing und Employer Branding Initiativen auf Data & Analytics : Deine Pipeline baust du basierend auf fundierten Daten und nutzt diese auch aktiv in der Hiring Manager Beratung Candidate Champion : Du optimierst gemeinsam mit dem Team unsere Prozesse und leitest eigene OKR-Projekte, um unsere Candidate Experience kontinuierlich zu verbessern Inspire us by Background : Abgeschlossenes Studium und ca. 2 - 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Recruiting von Business-Rollen in einem dynamischen Umfeld Expertise : Sehr
